query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_auction_cars, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN isAvailable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as available,
       SUM(CASE WHEN auctionEndDate > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active,
       SUM(CASE WHEN dealerId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_dealer
FROM cars 
WHERE isAuction = 1;
